trainingProtocol.loss: Known positive target: normalized waveformL1 plus mean over256/512/1024 STFT spectral convergence and logmagnitudeL1. Mixedpair: mean of both positive losses plus normalized predicted-sum mixture consistency. Absent identity: normalized absolute output only. Same original PS4 complete backbone and zero spatial adapters; speaker encoder frozen. No ASR teacher loss this trial.
trainingProtocol.advancementGate: Both unseen source meetings must improve mean known-mixture normalizedL1; aggregate positive target normalizedL1 must beat silent output (<1), mixedpair RMS-gain error and single-target waveform loss must not regress, and absent mean output/inputRMS must not regress. If any fail, stop this candidate; no learning-rate/epoch/gain sweep. If pass, decode all frozen new natural queries before/after with the same frozen recognizer and count all target-present errors and empty-target insertions. Supervised enrollment pilot is not automatic-meeting or sale qualification.
